intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Prepare one independent, random, complex photographic test concept, use the attached image only as facial-appearance guidance, generate an image, and judge the rendered pixels. This arm independently selects future civic transit and three agent-owned pose-geometry interpretations; none is a requester-supplied definition.

Create a photorealistic, full-body civic-technology editorial of one clearly adult woman, age 28, inside a flood-resilient underground maglev transfer platform during an emergency drill. She calibrates an emergency gyroscopic platform beacon as amber stabilization rings activate above wet basalt tiles. Her fully opaque graphite utility coverall, reflective piping, gloves, and armored ankle boots suit the work. Her facial appearance draws only from the attached reference: softly oval face, almond-shaped brown eyes, straight dark brows, natural rose lips, and long center-parted dark waves. Show frontal-plane pelvic obliquity under single-leg support: her entire weight is borne by the straight left leg while the pelvis tilts laterally, making the hip points visibly unequal in height. Show staggered leg depth separation: her right leg trails backward in depth with the whole right boot lifted just above the floor. Show head-shoulder opposition: her shoulders angle left toward the beacon while her head turns right to check an arriving service capsule. Use a head-to-toe vertical frame with both boots entirely visible and unobscured.
